arStrings.szText:
Casting a {c_important}Greater Demon{/c} Skill increases {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skill Cast Speed by {c_number}[{SF_2}*100|+%|]{/c} and Cooldown Rate by {c_number}[{SF_1}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:SUMMONED_GREATER_DEMON}{/c} seconds.

When {c_number}[SF_5]{/c} of your {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} die, your next {c_important}Greater Demon{/c} Skill Cast has no Dominance Cost.
